title: Mortgage schemes: Improving disclosure for retail investors
subject: This guide addresses disclosure for retail investors in unlisted mortgage schemes by setting out benchmarks and disclosure principles to help investors understand and assess these schemes. It also provides advertising standards for both unlisted and listed mortgage schemes offered to retail investors.
background: The guide is issued under the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) and aims to improve disclosure while maintaining the flexibility of the public fundraising process. It is intended for responsible entities, compliance committees, compliance plan auditors, valuers, publishers, and others involved in issuing or advertising interests in mortgage schemes.
ruling: ASIC sets out eight benchmarks for unlisted mortgage schemes covering areas such as loan-to-value ratios, valuation policies, and related party transactions, and expects responsible entities to disclose how they meet these benchmarks or explain why they do not. The guide also establishes disclosure principles requiring clear, concise, and effective information in product disclosure statements. For advertising, ASIC expects responsible entities and publishers to ensure advertisements are not misleading or deceptive and comply with specific standards, including balanced presentation of risks and returns. ASIC states that it will monitor compliance and may take regulatory action if benchmarks or principles are not adequately addressed.
